e:started.name: Balances Equilibrium: what the demo page shows
Icons: below 80 px and below 200 px, the same for any parameters
1 · Two thresholds with nominals: every status, both jumps

x = $32k = Tₘᵢₙ − τₘᵢₙ → Swept In Full $8k

x = $15k = Tₘᵢₙ − A → Swept In Full $25k
